description: This file contains implementation of Vulkan tensor utilities and the vTensor class for managing GPU tensor data, including stride calculations, memory layout, and resource management.

classes.name: vTensor
classes.description: Represents a GPU tensor with associated memory and metadata, supporting resize, reallocation, and resource management.

classes.name: vTensorStorage
classes.description: Manages Vulkan image or buffer resources backing a tensor, including allocation, transition, and reallocation.

methods.name: calc_contiguous_strides
methods.description: Calculates strides for a contiguous tensor based on sizes.

methods.name: calc_channels_last_strides
methods.description: Calculates strides for channels-last memory format.

methods.name: calc_strides
methods.description: Calculates tensor strides based on sizes, memory layout, and storage type.

methods.name: calc_gpu_sizes
methods.description: Adjusts tensor sizes for GPU storage, aligning dimensions as needed.

methods.name: create_image_extents
methods.description: Creates extents for Vulkan image textures based on tensor sizes and memory layout.

methods.name: make_metadata_uniform
methods.description: Creates a uniform buffer with tensor size and stride metadata for Vulkan shaders.
